title: Caring for the Vulnerable
definition: Caring for the vulnerable is the biblical call to protect, serve, honor, and help those who are weak, poor, hurting, disabled, oppressed, lonely, or in need.
summary: God cares deeply for the vulnerable, and His people are called to reflect His compassion through justice, mercy, presence, and practical help.
christFocus: Christ showed compassion to the weak, sick, poor, outcast, and burdened, revealing the heart of God.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: God cares deeply for the vulnerable, and His people are called to reflect His compassion through justice, mercy, presence, and practical help.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This doctrine matters because it helps believers follow Christ faithfully, think biblically, love others rightly, and live with wisdom, humility, and hope.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Receive this truth with humility, compare it with Scripture, bring it into prayer, and let it shape your relationships, choices, service, witness, and daily walk with Christ.
